---

## Summary

This feature replaces the rudimentary Android app UI with a rich, animated Jetpack Compose interface modeled after the legacy `archive/dashboard` Next.js app. It also fully integrates the Android app with the Firebase RTDB v2 schema, allowing it to stream real-time telemetry (water level wave animations, flow rate) and write commands to the device shadow.

---

## Constitution Gate *(must pass before Phase 0)*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Fail Toward Pump OFF | ☑ Pass | The app relies on firmware for safety; app UI will display exact `reported` state and reflect lockout states. |
| II. Dry-Run Lockout | ☑ Pass | UI will present error state and provide a clear, intentional reset button. |
| III. Overflow Protection | ☑ Pass | Same as II; UI reflects overflow fault and provides reset. |
| IV. TOR Independence | ☑ Pass | N/A to app layer (hardware cutout is independent). |
| V. Sensor Freshness / E-Stop | ☑ Pass | App will indicate if telemetry is stale. E-Stop is provided. |
| VI. Backward Compatibility | ☑ Pass | App is adopting the v2 additive RTDB schema gracefully. |

## Phase 2: Android App Implementation

**Build command**: `cd app && ./gradlew assembleDebug`
**Validation**: Run on physical Android device or emulator.

### Layer 1: Data & State (Firebase Integration)
- [ ] Create `DeviceRepository` interface and Firebase implementation to observe `/devices/{id}/telemetry` and `/devices/{id}/shadow/reported`.
- [ ] Implement write functions for `/devices/{id}/shadow/desired` and `/devices/{id}/settings`.
- [ ] Update `DashboardViewModel` to expose `StateFlow<DashboardUiState>` consuming the repository.

### Layer 2: UI Design System & Theme (Google Stitch)
- [ ] Add `Theme.kt`, `Color.kt`, `Type.kt` importing the Google Stitch M3 color scheme.
- [ ] Setup Typography: Hanken Grotesk (headlines), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (labels/telemetry).
- [ ] Configure `surface` (#0F172A) and `surfaceVariant` (#1E293B) colors for the calm baseline.

### Layer 3: Jetpack Compose Components
- [ ] Implement `TankLevelCard.kt` with a custom `Canvas` drawing the fluid wave animation (Cyan fill for normal operation, desaturated for stale data).
- [ ] Implement `PumpStatusCard.kt` with the Emerald glowing active halo (`glowPulse` equivalent) and monospaced flow rate display. Includes live Countdown Timer when in COUNTDOWN mode.
- [ ] Implement `ControlPanel.kt` with segmented toggle (`AUTO/MANUAL/COUNTDOWN`) with 24px radius, duration selectors, and a high-visibility Red E-Stop pill button.
- [ ] Implement `DiagnosticsCard.kt` for signal strength and uptime.
- [ ] Implement `ActivityPanel.kt` (Event Log) tracking system transitions.
- [ ] Implement `ConfigBottomSheet.kt` for threshold sliders.

### Layer 4: Screen Integration
- [ ] Wire the components into `DashboardScreen.kt`, passing the `DashboardUiState` down.
- [ ] Handle offline/disconnected UI states gracefully.

**Checkpoint**: App builds clean, UI animations run smoothly at 60fps, and Firebase RTDB changes are immediately reflected in the app.
